basic_details.job_title: Cabinet Secretariat Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 - Apply Offline
basic_details.short_information: Cabinet Secretariat has officially released the Staff Car Driver Recruitment 2026 notification for 4 vacancies. Eligible 10th-class passed candidates aged up to 56 years can apply offline by 20-11-2026 through the prescribed application process. Selected candidates will be appointed on a deputation basis with a salary of Rs. 19,900 - 63,200 per month. The official notification PDF and offline application details are available below.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 56 years. | To avoid any confusion regarding age eligibility, candidates can use our Age Calculator to calculate their exact age based on the prescribed cut-off date before applying.

qualification.education_qualification: 10th class passed from a recognised Board
qualification.details: 10th class passed from a recognised Board. Possession of a valid driving license for motor cars. Knowledge of motor mechanism. Experience of driving a motor car for at least three years.

how_to_apply: Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: https://cabsec.gov.in/.
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 20-11-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the Cabinet Secretariat Staff Car Driver recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) post is 20th November 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address before this deadline.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for the Staff Car Driver post?
faq.answer: Candidates must have passed the 10th class from a recognized Board. Additionally, a valid driving license for motor cars, knowledge of motor mechanisms, and at least three years of driving experience are mandatory.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for applying to this post?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for applying to the Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) post is 56 years. There is no minimum age limit specified in the provided data.

faq.question: Q4. How many vacancies are available for the Staff Car Driver position?
faq.answer: There are a total of 4 vacancies for the post of Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) in the Cabinet Secretariat.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the Staff Car Driver post?
faq.answer: The selected candidates for the Staff Car Driver (Ordinary Grade) post will receive a salary in the pay scale of Rs. 19900 - 63200 per month.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application mode for this recruitment is offline. Candidates need to send their duly filled application forms to the official address mentioned in the notification.

faq.question: Q7. What is the selection process for the Staff Car Driver role?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Staff Car Driver post includes Document Verification and ACR/APAR Assessment. Candidates will be shortlisted based on these stages.

faq.question: Q8. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment. Candidates can apply without paying any fee.

faq.question: Q9. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment is A-12011/01/2024-Ad.I.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and application form?
faq.answer: The official notification and application form can be downloaded from the official website of the Cabinet Secretariat, which is https://cabsec.gov.in/. Links are provided in the "Important Links" section.
